questions.qtext: Which one of the following is not a property of a material?
questions.solution:
(b)
Proof resilience is the maximum energy absorbed by member within the elastic limit and depends on the volume of material. Hence, it is not a property of a material.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statement(s) regarding shear centre of a cross-section is/are CORRECT?

options.text: For a doubly symmetric cross-section, shear centre always coincides with the centroid of the cross-section.
If the resultant transverse shear load acting at a cross-section passes through its shear centre,then the section will be subjected to bending moment only.
If the resultant transverse shear load acting at a cross-section passes through its shear centre, then the section will be subjected to twisting moment only.

If the resultant transverse shear load acting at a cross-section does not passes through its shear centre, then the section will be subjected to bending moment as well as twisting moment simultaneously.
